request.name: Woodland Satchel
request.prompt: Create a production game UI texture, not a mockup. Match the supplied woodland ant RTS interface: dimensional warm dark bark, hand-carved irregular branches, ochre cut edges, tiny amber knots, a few olive leaves, restrained warm highlights. Chonky believable craftsmanship with readable clear silhouette; no wispy vines, no gold metal filigree. Straight-on screen view, no perspective. No text, portraits, icons, numbers or scenery. True alpha transparency, never a checkerboard painted into the image. One modest empty dark umber natural leather satchel backing for a four-slot inventory. Front-on square open worn leather bag silhouette, soft stitched leather folds and small wooden toggle near top. Near-black suede center kept plain, no pockets dividing center, no items, no grid. Bag fits within x=80..944 y=80..944. Low-contrast desaturated brown, restrained rim highlights: the inventory icons added later must dominate. Transparent exterior background.
